measure_name: Project-financed climate and disaster risk assessment
definition: Evaluates natural hazards, exposure, vulnerability or service disruption to inform investment, design or operations for existing or proposed infrastructure. Includes screening, hazard mapping and technical hazard studies. Excludes Bank appraisal screening and unrelated assessments. Standing assessment rules are climate_governance; ongoing monitoring services are climate_information_systems. Assessment findings alone do not establish implementation of recommended measures.
